[SWS_DM_01432] SOVD method Read Single Data Value from an Entity data query
⌈
The SOVD attribute data in the response body of the SOVD
method Read Single Data Value from an Entity shall be queried analog to
Service ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22) of ISO 14229-1[1] using the same instance of the
data querying mechanism.
⌋

[SWS_DM_01432] SOVD method Read a data resource from an Entity – data query
⌈
If the SOVD method Read a data ressource is received, the DM shall call the
corresponding ara::diag::GenericDiagnosticSovdContent::Read method
and send a response body according to ASAM SOVD [5][14] and set the following
attribute values:
id to shortName of DiagnosticSovdContent,
data as enumeration of all DiagnosticSovdContentElements aggregated by the
DiagnosticSovdContent with:
ValueName set to the shortName of the DiagnosticSovdContentElement
Value retrieved by [SWS_DM_02165]
⌋
